note: Extract-UwpFeatureChecklist could not parse the sample's scenario list (SampleConfiguration) and modeled the app as a single MainPage feature with 4 shell controls. The live UWP app + source confirm the sample is a 13-scenario 'Application Resources' shell. Rubric below reflects the single measured feature (the shell + default scenario) that the parity pipeline actually captured and compared.

features.name: Application Resources sample shell + scenario navigation
features.description: MainPage shell: sample title, a scenario navigation list (ScenarioControl ListBox in UWP), copyright, and Trademarks/Privacy footer HyperlinkButtons, plus the default scenario content demonstrating x:Uid string-resource lookup.
expected_behaviour: App launches and presents a non-blank window
A scenario navigation list exposes every scenario and selecting an item navigates to that scenario's content
Default scenario shows the x:Uid-bound resource string ('Hello World') resolved from resources.resw
Sample title and '(c) Microsoft Corporation' copyright are shown
Trademarks and Privacy footer links are present (they open external URLs; no in-app response in the UWP original)
